description: §6.6.9 / §20.5 (S449 ruling item 1) — the clean control: the server reads its own session as `session.userId` (§20.5), and `@session` appears only in CLIENT code (the §20.5 projection: `@session.current` in markup, `@session.destroy()` in a client function). No E-SESSION-AMBIENT-SERVER.
rationale: §20.5: '`session` is a compiler-provided scope binding available only inside server-escalated function bodies.' The ruling (user-voice-scrml.md S449 item 1) refuses `@session` in a server context only; the client projection is unaffected.
